sections.title: 核心性格与能力
sections.headline: 判断之后，把理解落到现实
insights: 三庚并见：自己的判断系统
水势明显：观察、表达与变化
印比承载：让敏锐成为稳定能力
interpretation: 你的核心能力，来自庚金的判断、原则与边界，也来自申子辰水势带来的观察、理解和表达。三庚并见，使你很难只凭权威接受结论；你更在意逻辑、事实与实际经验能否相互对上。这样的独立判断，成熟以后会成为筛选信息与辨认结构的能力。
敏锐不等于只会反对。遇到复杂问题，你往往先拆开来看，再重新组织信息，最后辨认怎样才能落实。规则若合理、有效，你可以执行得很彻底；若要求长期放弃判断，能力便容易停留在配合，而没有转成真正的成果。
这张盘保留中和偏弱的承载判断。理解与输出持续增加时，基础、方法和支持也需要跟上。土的承载与金的边界不是压低敏锐，而是让判断、理解、重组和落地形成完整循环，避免每次都靠自己临时撑住。

sections.technicalCaptionEn: Three Geng stems emphasize judgment and boundaries. Zi month and the Shen–Zi–Chen water configuration support expression through the Output stars; Jia Indirect Wealth connects output with practical value. Yin–Shen tension remains. The moderately weak reading calls for Earth support and Metal assistance.
sections.applicationCaptionZh: 在工作讨论里，你可能先发现方案的漏洞，再理解各方需求，最后把分散的信息重组成可用的方法。判断、理解、重组与落地不是性格分数，而是三庚、水势、财星与承载条件共同形成的观察路径。
sections.applicationCaptionEn: In a work discussion, you may notice a weakness, understand competing needs, then reorganize scattered information into a useful method. Judgment, understanding, reorganization and implementation describe an interpretive pathway, rather than personality scores.

例如面对一个看似成熟的安排，你可能很快发现其中的矛盾，却还需要时间说明问题究竟在哪里。若只停留在指出不足，别人容易把判断理解成否定；当你能把观察接成证据、方法和可执行的步骤，敏锐才更容易进入合作。甲木财星让现实采用成为检验，土金则提供稳定表达与持续完成所需的基础。这不是要求你放弃自己的判断，而是让判断得到更充分的承载。
interpretationEn: Your capability combines Geng Metal judgment with the observation and expression of the water configuration. Three Geng stems make logic, evidence and experience more persuasive than authority alone. Mature independence helps you distinguish useful information and understand how a situation is organized.

Sensitivity need not end in objection. You may take a complex problem apart, reconnect its pieces and identify a practical way forward. Clear, effective rules can support thorough execution; prolonged compliance that excludes your judgment may leave your ability underused.

The moderately weak structural reading remains. More understanding and output also need stronger foundations, methods and support. Earth carrying and Metal boundaries complete the movement from judgment through understanding and reorganization to delivery.

For example, detecting a contradiction is only the beginning. If you stop at criticism, others may hear rejection. Turning the observation into evidence, a method and workable steps makes cooperation easier. Jia Wealth brings the test of practical adoption; Earth and Metal help you explain and finish consistently, without surrendering your judgment.

sections.title: 人生结构与运行方式
sections.headline: 稳定，是能够进入下一层
insights: 年柱：早期秩序与现实感
月柱：资源与社会要求
日时：承载与重新选择
interpretation: 你的人生结构更像不断形成基础、进入环境、承担责任，再在原有结构里长出下一阶段的变化。四柱的不同位置，为早期环境、成年现实、自我位置和后续方向提供观察线索；这里没有把柱位换算成固定年龄，也没有把人生排成必然发生的事件。
庚申所对应的早期秩序，容易让你注意规则、能力和资源差异。甲子把输出与现实价值拉到社会位置上；庚辰涉及自己能否承载，庚寅则保留新的方向感。它们构成相互牵动的领域，而不是四段彼此割裂的命运。
有价值的稳定，不只是一直不变，而是每一阶段都有可靠基础。原来的安排曾经有效，却未必能继续容纳下一层发展。寅申冲与申子辰关系并存，因此维持已有结构与重新选择方向，可以同时成为你长期需要理解的张力。
sections.headlineZh: 稳定，是能够进入下一层
sections.headlineEn: Stability that can hold the next stage
sections.subheadlineZh: 四柱的位置，连接不同生活领域
sections.subheadlineEn: Four positions connect different life domains
sections.technicalCaptionZh: 年柱庚申、月柱甲子、日柱庚辰与时柱庚寅分别提供起点、社会现实、自我位置与后续方向的观察线索。申子辰三合条件与寅申冲同时保留，稳定与重构并存，不把柱位换算为固定年龄。
sections.technicalCaptionEn: Geng–Shen, Jia–Zi, Geng–Chen and Geng–Yin provide lenses on origins, social reality, self-position and later direction. The Shen–Zi–Chen configuration and Yin–Shen clash coexist, linking stability and reorganization without assigning fixed ages to pillar positions.
sections.applicationCaptionZh: 进入一个环境以后，你可能先理解规则，再承担责任，逐渐积累可用的方法与资源。阶段完成不必等于失败；当原来的安排不能容纳新的发展，重构可以延续已有基础，而不是把所有积累推倒。
sections.applicationCaptionEn: You may enter an environment, learn its rules, take responsibility and accumulate methods and resources. Completing a stage need not mean failure. Reorganization can carry useful foundations forward when an earlier arrangement no longer holds the next development.
interpretationZh: 你的人生结构更像不断形成基础、进入环境、承担责任，再在原有结构里长出下一阶段的变化。四柱的不同位置，为早期环境、成年现实、自我位置和后续方向提供观察线索；这里没有把柱位换算成固定年龄，也没有把人生排成必然发生的事件。

例如一种工作或生活安排曾让你获得秩序、经验与收入，后来却开始限制你能够参与的事情。此时真正的分歧，未必是喜欢还是不喜欢，而是原有位置还能不能容纳新的能力和责任。重新选择并不自动否定过去；已经积累的方法、关系和现实基础仍可进入下一层。S03关注各领域如何同时运行，长期阶段怎样转换，则在后面的周期章节展开。
interpretationEn: Your life structure can be read as establishing a foundation, entering an environment, carrying responsibility and developing beyond the arrangement that first supported you. The pillar positions offer connected lenses, rather than fixed ages or inevitable events.

Geng–Shen draws attention to early order, ability and resource differences. Jia–Zi brings output and practical value into social life. Geng–Chen concerns your own carrying position; Geng–Yin retains a developing direction. These domains affect one another.

Useful stability is more than remaining unchanged: each stage needs a dependable foundation. An arrangement can have worked well while no longer accommodating further development. The water configuration and Yin–Shen tension keep continuity and renewed direction in view together.

For example, a job may have provided income and experience yet now limit your contribution. The question becomes whether its position can hold your developing capability and responsibility. A new choice can retain methods, relationships and foundations already built. This section concerns simultaneous life domains; the later cycle section examines transitions over time.

sections.title: 事业发展与职业方向
sections.headline: 把认知变成可重复的价值
insights: 输出怎样被客户或组织采用
责任、权限与资源能否匹配
方法能否从个人能力变成系统
interpretation: 事业的重点不是指定一个固定职业，而是能力、资源、市场和责任怎样连接。月干甲木偏财与命局食伤结构相接，使认知、经验、判断和方法能否成为别人愿意使用的成果，成为职业发展的重要观察点。只完成流程，未必足以让你感到能力被真正使用。
完整价值链包含看见问题、理解问题、形成解决方式、落实结果，以及让结果被采用。输出若只有速度与数量，却没有承载条件，链条仍可能停在个人忙碌。职责增加以后，权限、制度和可用资源能否同步进入，会影响成果是否稳定。
可重复的方法，让价值逐渐离开单次表现。土所代表的基础与承载、金所保留的判断与边界，帮助知识进入流程和结构。规模扩大是否有意义，要看这些条件能否一起增加；并不是越忙、职位越高或项目越多就一定越好。
sections.headlineZh: 把认知变成可重复的价值
sections.subheadlineZh: 食伤生财，输出需要现实采用
sections.subheadlineEn: Output becomes value through practical adoption
sections.technicalCaptionZh: 庚金生食伤水，水再接甲木偏财；子中癸伤官当令、申中壬食神及辰中癸伤官提供输出来源。丙七杀藏寅带入责任，三庚保留自主判断，土金承载决定价值链能否持续，而非保证职位提升。
sections.technicalCaptionEn: Geng Metal feeds Water Output, which connects with Jia Indirect Wealth. Gui Hurting Officer in Zi and Chen, and Ren Eating God in Shen, supply the output pathway. Bing Seven Killings hidden in Yin adds responsibility. Judgment and Earth–Metal support condition continuity.
sections.applicationCaptionZh: 专业认知经过可用方案、客户或组织采用，才能形成可重复的价值。责任增加时，需要同步理解权限、资源与结果的关系；否则方法仍可能困在一个人的忙碌里，难以成为可靠的交付结构。
sections.applicationCaptionEn: Professional cognition becomes repeatable value through usable solutions and adoption by customers or organizations. Greater responsibility also needs authority, resources and results to align; otherwise useful methods can remain trapped in one person’s workload.
interpretationZh: 事业的重点不是指定一个固定职业，而是能力、资源、市场和责任怎样连接。月干甲木偏财与命局食伤结构相接，使认知、经验、判断和方法能否成为别人愿意使用的成果，成为职业发展的重要观察点。只完成流程，未必足以让你感到能力被真正使用。

可重复的方法，让价值逐渐离开单次表现。土所代表的基础与承载、金所保留的判断与边界，帮助知识进入流程和结构。规模扩大是否有意义，要看这些条件能否一起增加；并不是越忙、职位越高或项目越多就一定越好。
例如同样面对一项复杂需求，只照流程完成与参与问题判断，带来的职业体验可能很不同。你看见的价值需要被整理成方案、服务、产品或制度，让别人能够使用，而不只是存在于个人经验中。七杀所对应的责任不能替代资源，个人判断也不能替代组织协作。发展方向因而要看能力有没有进入成果形成，以及成果能否在合适的权限、分工和承载条件下重复产生。
interpretationEn: Career is read through connections among capability, resources, markets and responsibility, rather than a prescribed occupation. Jia Indirect Wealth on the month stem meets the Output structure: experience, judgment and methods matter when others can use them. Completing procedures alone may leave your ability underused.

The value chain includes noticing a problem, understanding it, forming a solution, delivering and gaining adoption. Speed or volume without support can leave the chain at personal busyness. As duties grow, authority, systems and available resources influence whether results remain dependable.

Repeatable methods let value extend beyond a single performance. Earth foundations and Metal boundaries help knowledge enter processes. Greater scale matters when these conditions grow with it; more projects or a higher position do not automatically improve the structure.

For example, following a process and helping diagnose a complex need may feel very different. Your insight needs a usable form: a solution, service, product or system. Responsibility does not replace resources, nor independent judgment teamwork. Direction depends on whether capability contributes to results and whether those results can recur with suitable authority, division of work and support.

sections.title: 资源与财富
sections.headline: 收入之后，还有留存与选择
insights: 甲木偏财：外部机会与流动
乙木正财：持续安排与积累
承载条件决定资源能否留下
interpretation: 这张盘并不缺财星：甲木偏财透在月干，辰中也有乙木正财。财富读取因此不止问有没有机会，而是收入从哪里来、怎样流动、哪些成果能够留下。偏财对应项目、客户和资源配置的机会感；正财则让持续安排与积累进入视野。
职业成果进入收入以后，还要经过留存、配置和沉淀，才更接近自己的资源基础。资金不断流动，并不自动等于资源越来越厚；机会出现时所需承担的成本、责任与时间，也会改变最终能够留下的部分。图中的链条呈现这些条件，不是回报率或资产估值。
资源成熟以后，重要性逐渐转向未来的选择权。稳定基础能否支持下一步，比单次进账更能解释持续性。印比承载条件仍然保留，因此输出与财的放大不是无条件有利；这里不指定投资产品、不预测金额，也不承诺必然发财。
sections.headlineZh: 收入之后，还有留存与选择
sections.subheadlineZh: 偏财的机会，正财的持续安排
sections.subheadlineEn: Opportunity and continuity have distinct roles
sections.technicalCaptionZh: 甲木偏财透月，乙木正财藏辰，显示机会流动与持续安排两类线索。三庚比肩让资源互动与自主边界进入读取，辰土提供承载与储存的解释意象。收入必须经过成本、责任和留存条件，不能直接等同财富。
sections.technicalCaptionEn: Jia Indirect Wealth is exposed on the month stem; Yi Direct Wealth is hidden in Chen. Opportunity and continuity are distinct lenses. Three Geng Peer stars introduce resource interaction and boundaries; Chen offers a carrying and storage metaphor. Income is not automatically retained wealth.
sections.applicationCaptionZh: 收入经过留存、配置与持久资源，才逐渐形成选择空间。外部机会越多，越要辨认时间、成本和责任如何影响留下来的部分；图示呈现条件之间的联系，不提供投资产品、回报率或资产估值。
sections.applicationCaptionEn: Income passes through retention, allocation and durable resources before expanding choice. Opportunities also consume time, cost and responsibility. The diagram shows these conditions; it does not prescribe investments, returns or asset values.
interpretationZh: 这张盘并不缺财星：甲木偏财透在月干，辰中也有乙木正财。财富读取因此不止问有没有机会，而是收入从哪里来、怎样流动、哪些成果能够留下。偏财对应项目、客户和资源配置的机会感；正财则让持续安排与积累进入视野。
职业成果进入收入以后，还要经过留存、配置和沉淀，才更接近自己的资源基础。资金不断流动，并不自动等于资源越来越厚；机会出现时所需承担的成本、责任与时间，也会改变最终能够留下的部分。图中的链条呈现这些条件，不是回报率或资产估值。
资源成熟以后，重要性逐渐转向未来的选择权。稳定基础能否支持下一步，比单次进账更能解释持续性。印比承载条件仍然保留，因此输出与财的放大不是无条件有利；这里不指定投资产品、不预测金额，也不承诺必然发财。
例如项目带来一笔收入，却同时需要追加投入、延长交付或承担更多照顾责任，进账与真正可用的资源便会出现差别。正财的持续安排，让这种差别进入日常结构，而不只在机会出现时临时处理。辰的承载意象也不是保证能够存财，而是提醒读取时保留基础、制度和可持续性的条件。当这些部分清楚，资源才更可能支持未来选择，而不是反复被下一轮扩张消耗。
interpretationEn: This chart contains both Jia Indirect Wealth on the month stem and Yi Direct Wealth hidden in Chen. The reading asks where income comes from, how it moves and what remains. Indirect Wealth highlights projects, customers and resource opportunities; Direct Wealth brings continuity and accumulation into view.

Professional results become a resource foundation through retention, allocation and consolidation. Money moving continuously does not necessarily deepen that foundation. The costs, responsibilities and time attached to opportunities affect the portion you retain.

As resources mature, future choice becomes more meaningful than a single receipt. Earth–Metal carrying conditions remain: expanding output and Wealth is not unconditionally beneficial. This reading promises neither investment returns nor inevitable wealth.

For example, project income may require further spending, extended delivery or added caring duties. Receipts and available resources then differ. Direct Wealth’s continuity lens brings this distinction into routine arrangements. Chen’s storage metaphor is no guarantee; foundations, systems and sustainability remain conditions. Clearer arrangements can help resources support later choices rather than disappear into repeated expansion.

sections.title: 关系与亲密模式
sections.headline: 信任，要在共同现实中成立
insights: 好感是开始，兑现让信任累积
亲密与自己的判断可以并存
共同承担决定长期结构
interpretation: 进入关系以后，你重视的不只是有没有感情，而是对方在现实里是否可靠。三庚并见所保留的判断与边界，使语言、态度与行动能否一致，成为信任的重要来源。好感、吸引和聊得来可以推动开始，但更深的关系仍会进入共同生活的检验。
承诺有没有兑现，压力出现时怎样分担，遇到问题是否愿意继续面对，这些细节会在时间中累积。图里的信任、边界、共同现实和成长是相互作用的条件，不是对某个人的评分。关系的成熟，也不等于任何一方要放弃自己才能维持亲密。
吸引与长期结构有不同作用。前者让彼此靠近，后者让责任、空间与未来安排逐渐清楚。命盘提供的是观察这些模式的视角，不能据此判定某段关系会走到哪里，也不能把结构张力写成必然离婚或预定伴侣。
sections.headlineZh: 信任，要在共同现实中成立
sections.headlineEn: Trust takes shape in shared reality
sections.subheadlineZh: 吸引与长期承载，需要分别理解
sections.technicalCaptionZh: 甲木财星、日支辰、三庚判断与寅申冲共同提供关系读取线索。财星涉及现实连接，日支强调共同生活的承载，三庚保留自主边界，冲的张力使方向协调可见；这些线索不用于指定伴侣或断定关系结果。
sections.technicalCaptionEn: Jia Wealth, the Chen day branch, three Geng stems and Yin–Shen tension anchor the relationship reading. They connect practical involvement, shared-life carrying, autonomy and direction. These lenses neither identify a destined partner nor determine a relationship outcome.
sections.applicationCaptionZh: 吸引让彼此靠近，一致行动让信任积累，边界让共同生活保持清楚。短期好感与长期标准并不相同；压力出现时能否回应、承诺能否兑现，以及未来安排怎样共同承担，才让关系逐渐进入现实。
sections.applicationCaptionEn: Attraction brings people closer; consistent action builds trust; boundaries clarify shared life. Initial chemistry and long-term criteria differ. Responsiveness under pressure, fulfilled commitments and shared future arrangements make the relationship practical.
interpretationZh: 进入关系以后，你重视的不只是有没有感情，而是对方在现实里是否可靠。三庚并见所保留的判断与边界，使语言、态度与行动能否一致，成为信任的重要来源。好感、吸引和聊得来可以推动开始，但更深的关系仍会进入共同生活的检验。
承诺有没有兑现，压力出现时怎样分担，遇到问题是否愿意继续面对，这些细节会在时间中累积。图里的信任、边界、共同现实和成长是相互作用的条件，不是对某个人的评分。关系的成熟，也不等于任何一方要放弃自己才能维持亲密。
吸引与长期结构有不同作用。前者让彼此靠近，后者让责任、空间与未来安排逐渐清楚。命盘提供的是观察这些模式的视角，不能据此判定某段关系会走到哪里，也不能把结构张力写成必然离婚或预定伴侣。
例如一次承诺看起来很小，却可能让你观察到对方如何处理现实：是否记得、是否解释变化、是否愿意承担后果。这样的细节比抽象态度更能建立信任。日支辰的承载视角把共同生活带入关系，三庚则让亲密与自己的判断并存。若方向不同，寅申冲的张力需要通过沟通和安排被理解，而不是被写成预定的分离；图中呈现的是需要协调的条件，不是对某个人的评判。
interpretationEn: In a relationship, affection matters alongside practical reliability. Three Geng stems retain judgment and boundaries, making consistency among words, attitudes and action a significant source of trust. Attraction can begin a relationship, while deeper intimacy encounters shared-life demands.

Fulfilled promises, division of pressure and willingness to face problems accumulate over time. Trust, boundaries, shared reality and growth are interacting conditions, rather than a score for another person. Intimacy does not require either person to abandon themselves.

Attraction and long-term structure have different roles. One brings people closer; the other clarifies responsibility, space and future arrangements. The chart cannot determine where a particular relationship will end.

For example, a small promise reveals whether someone remembers, explains changes and accepts consequences. Such details may build trust more effectively than broad declarations. Chen’s carrying lens introduces shared life, while Geng retains autonomy. Different directions need communication and practical coordination; Yin–Shen tension is not a predetermined separation or a judgment of someone’s character.

sections.title: 家庭与支持系统
sections.headline: 支持，让责任不只落在你身上
insights: 家庭参与长期现实选择
能处理问题不等于无限负责
支持需要成为可见的分担
interpretation: 家庭不是生活之外的背景。年柱庚申、日支辰与时支寅的前后牵动，使照顾、资源安排和责任分配容易参与重要选择。你可能很早就注意谁比较辛苦、谁可靠、哪些问题不能只靠情绪处理；这些观察，也会逐渐形成在家庭里的位置。
责任感强，并不等于愿意无限延伸。一个人经常能找到办法，周围便可能把更多事情交给他。家庭支持是否有效，要看分担能否进入现实：谁处理事务、谁提供资源、谁承担照顾，以及谁在压力出现时仍能保持回应。
图中的伴侣、父母与子女是阅读关系的角色，不代表你目前一定拥有这些家庭成员。共同生活需要保留各自空间，照顾也需要承载条件。可靠的支持，让你在承担家庭时仍能保留发展方向，而不是把所有问题继续集中在同一个人身上。
sections.headlineZh: 支持，让责任不只落在你身上
sections.subheadlineZh: 角色之间，责任与支持双向流动
sections.subheadlineEn: Responsibility and support move between roles
sections.technicalCaptionZh: 年柱庚申提供早期秩序的线索，日支辰涉及共同生活承载，时柱庚寅保留后续方向；寅申冲让前后位置的张力可见。家庭图用角色表达资源与照顾分配，不把柱位解释成固定年龄，也不假设你已有伴侣或子女。
sections.technicalCaptionEn: Geng–Shen offers an early-order lens, Chen concerns shared-life carrying, and Geng–Yin retains later direction. Yin–Shen tension connects these positions. The family map depicts roles and support; it assumes neither fixed ages nor an existing partner or children.
sections.applicationCaptionZh: 能处理问题的人，往往也更容易被交付更多责任。家庭支持要落实为谁处理事务、谁提供资源、谁承担照顾；可靠的分担同时保留各自发展空间，避免所有需要继续汇集到同一个人身上。
sections.applicationCaptionEn: Someone who solves problems may also receive more responsibility. Family support becomes tangible through handling tasks, providing resources and sharing care. Dependable support preserves development space rather than concentrating every need on one person.
interpretationZh: 家庭不是生活之外的背景。年柱庚申、日支辰与时支寅的前后牵动，使照顾、资源安排和责任分配容易参与重要选择。你可能很早就注意谁比较辛苦、谁可靠、哪些问题不能只靠情绪处理；这些观察，也会逐渐形成在家庭里的位置。
责任感强，并不等于愿意无限延伸。一个人经常能找到办法，周围便可能把更多事情交给他。家庭支持是否有效，要看分担能否进入现实：谁处理事务、谁提供资源、谁承担照顾，以及谁在压力出现时仍能保持回应。
图中的伴侣、父母与子女是阅读关系的角色，不代表你目前一定拥有这些家庭成员。共同生活需要保留各自空间，照顾也需要承载条件。可靠的支持，让你在承担家庭时仍能保留发展方向，而不是把所有问题继续集中在同一个人身上。
例如家里遇到一项长期事务，你可能先找到处理办法，之后却逐渐成为默认负责的人。问题不只在于愿不愿意承担，还在于任务、资源与决定权是否说清楚。年柱与时柱的方向张力，让早期责任和个人发展同时进入观察；日支的承载则把照顾放回共同生活的现实。图中的父母、伴侣和照顾对象是可供对照的角色位置，具体由谁承担、是否存在，仍要由你的真实家庭情境说明。
interpretationEn: Family is part of practical life rather than a separate background. The year pillar, day branch and hour position bring care, resources and responsibility into important choices. You may notice who struggles, who is dependable and which problems need more than emotional reassurance.

Being responsible does not mean carrying endlessly. When someone regularly finds a solution, others may give them more to handle. Support becomes effective through actual tasks, resources, care and continued responsiveness under pressure.

Partner, parents and dependants are reading roles, not claims about your current household. Shared life needs individual space and conditions that can carry care. Dependable support allows family participation alongside personal development.

For example, solving a continuing family task may gradually make you its default owner. Willingness is only part of the issue: tasks, resources and decision authority also need clarity. The year–hour tension keeps early responsibilities and later direction visible; the day branch returns care to shared-life arrangements. Your actual family context determines which roles exist and who carries them.

sections.title: 压力与脆弱点
sections.headline: 仍能运作，不代表没有超负荷
insights: 理解得快，可能同时接住更多事
外部正常与内部疲惫可以并存
支持、边界和恢复属于承载条件
interpretation: 压力未必首先表现为事情做不下去。三庚带来撑持力，明显的水势让你能够理解、分析和调整；外部看起来仍有办法，内部却可能持续承受更多负荷。当你总能继续处理，自己和周围的人都容易低估已经累积的消耗。
信息、责任与反复思考进入同一个承载系统。输入增加，分担却没有同步进入时，恢复空间便容易被挤压。图中没有测量健康、精力或压力分数，而是把接受稿所描述的负荷关系展开，让事情数量之外的消耗也能被看见。
土的基础与承载、金的边界与取舍，为持续运作提供条件。暂时放慢与重新组织并不等于能力消失；有时只是让负荷重新回到能承担的范围。这一章讨论生活与工作中的承载模式，不作疾病判断，也不把冲、刑、害解释成必然身体事件。

sections.subheadlineZh: 输出与承担，需要恢复的空间
sections.subheadlineEn: Output and responsibility need recovery space
sections.technicalCaptionZh: 三庚的撑持、水势的理解输出与寅申冲的方向张力，使能力与负荷同时进入读取。中和偏弱保留承载条件，土提供基础、金提供边界。此处观察输入、责任与恢复怎样连接，不以五行或冲刑害作医学诊断。
sections.technicalCaptionEn: Three Geng stems, water expression and Yin–Shen direction tension keep capability and load in view together. The moderately weak reading retains carrying conditions: Earth foundations and Metal boundaries. These are lenses on responsibility and recovery, not medical diagnosis.
sections.applicationCaptionZh: 信息输入与责任累积可能持续占用理解和判断；外部仍能交付，不代表内部还有同样多的余量。支持进入、重新定界与恢复空间，让负荷回到可承载范围，而不是把每次放慢都解释为能力下降。
sections.applicationCaptionEn: Information and responsibility may continuously occupy understanding and judgment. Continuing to deliver does not prove that internal capacity is unchanged. Support, renewed boundaries and recovery space can make the load manageable without treating slower movement as lost ability.
interpretationZh: 压力未必首先表现为事情做不下去。三庚带来撑持力，明显的水势让你能够理解、分析和调整；外部看起来仍有办法，内部却可能持续承受更多负荷。当你总能继续处理，自己和周围的人都容易低估已经累积的消耗。

例如任务数量没有明显增加，却因为每件事都需要反复判断、协调和解释，你可能已经承担了更多不易看见的工作。水势使理解保持活跃，三庚又让你继续找办法，于是外部较难察觉负荷的变化。土金的条件提醒这里还需要方法、支持和清楚的取舍。恢复不是额外奖励，而是持续运行所需的一部分；具体负荷怎样形成，要回到生活事实，不能由命盘代替身体状况或疾病判断。
interpretationEn: Pressure may appear before work becomes impossible. Geng persistence and water understanding can keep you analyzing and adapting while load grows internally. When you continue finding a way, both you and others may underestimate the accumulated effort.

Information, responsibility and repeated thought share a carrying system. If input grows without comparable support, recovery space can narrow. The diagram reveals interpretive relationships, rather than measuring health, energy or stress.

Earth foundations and Metal boundaries condition sustained operation. Slowing or reorganizing need not mean capability has disappeared; it may bring demands back within a manageable range. This section concerns life and work patterns, without diagnosing illness.

For example, the number of tasks may remain stable while each requires more judgment, coordination and explanation. Water keeps understanding active and Geng continues seeking solutions, making the extra work less visible. Methods, support and clear selection remain important. Recovery belongs within sustained operation; actual experience, rather than the chart, establishes how the load arose or how your body is doing.

sections.title: 长期周期与转折模式
sections.headline: 建立、扩张，再筛选与重组
insights: 周期模型没有固定年份或年龄
五行是不同作用，不是运程顺序
方向变化与基础积累可以并存
interpretation: 长期走势适合从周期来看：先积累，再扩张；先承载，再重组；把事情做起来以后，又重新理解哪些值得继续。庚金需要结构，水势推动变化，甲木指向现实成果，寅申冲保留方向张力。这些力量长期并存，不等于人生永远处于同一种节奏。
建立期可能在专业、收入或生活基础上积累，扩张期让成果进入更大的范围，筛选则把资源从所有可能性收回到值得继续的部分。重组以后，新的建立才有可靠起点。图示是解释变化的循环，没有指定哪年进入哪一阶段，也没有固定的必经顺序。
五行角色帮助分辨当前强调什么：土承载、金定界、水理解表达、木连接资源、火带入温暖与责任。它们不是木火土金水依次轮转的运程表。疲惫有时属于短期负荷，有时意味着旧结构接近完成；具体情境仍需要与你的实际经历对照。
sections.headlineZh: 建立、扩张，再筛选与重组
sections.subheadlineZh: 五行是作用，不是固定运程顺序
sections.subheadlineEn: Elements describe functions, not a fixed timetable
sections.technicalCaptionZh: 土承载、金定界、水理解输出、木连接资源、火调候并带入责任，是本盘保留的功能角色。寅申冲与三合水势并存，使积累和转向可以同时发生；这些作用不构成木火土金水的必经年代顺序。
sections.technicalCaptionEn: Earth carries, Metal sets boundaries, Water understands and expresses, Wood connects resources, and Fire brings seasonal warmth and responsibility. Yin–Shen tension coexists with the water configuration. These functions do not form an inevitable sequence of life periods.
sections.applicationCaptionZh: 建立让基础逐渐可靠，扩张让成果进入更大范围，筛选让资源回到值得继续的部分，重组则为再建立创造条件。循环可以回访，也可以局部发生；它帮助理解阶段变化，不指定哪年或哪岁必须转折。
sections.applicationCaptionEn: Building develops foundations; expansion extends results; selection returns resources to what merits continuation; reorganization enables renewed building. The cycle can recur or apply to one domain, without assigning a year or age to a transition.
interpretationZh: 长期走势适合从周期来看：先积累，再扩张；先承载，再重组；把事情做起来以后，又重新理解哪些值得继续。庚金需要结构，水势推动变化，甲木指向现实成果，寅申冲保留方向张力。这些力量长期并存，不等于人生永远处于同一种节奏。

五行角色帮助分辨当前强调什么：土承载、金定界、水理解表达、木连接资源、火带入温暖与责任。它们不是木火土金水依次轮转的运程表。疲惫有时属于短期负荷，有时意味着旧结构接近完成；具体情境仍需要与你的实际经历对照。
例如已经熟练的工作仍能运作，却不再形成新的空间，你可能需要先辨认这是短期疲惫，还是旧结构已经接近完成。若基础尚未建立，扩张可能只是增加负荷；若成果已有承载，筛选与重组又可能保留更多有效部分。S09关注阶段如何变化，不替代S03对同时存在的生活领域的观察。五行角色帮助辨认当下缺少什么条件，却不能单独把未来排成确定的好坏时期。
interpretationEn: Long-term development can be understood through cycles: accumulating and expanding, carrying and reorganizing. Geng seeks structure, Water encourages change, Jia connects practical results and Yin–Shen retains direction tension. Their coexistence does not mean one unchanging life rhythm.

Building may strengthen professional, income or living foundations. Expansion brings results into a wider setting; selection concentrates resources on what remains worthwhile. Reorganization can create a dependable starting point. These are interpretive phases, without fixed dates or mandatory order.

Element roles distinguish what a situation emphasizes: carrying, boundaries, expression, resources or warmth and responsibility. They are not a chronological element timetable. Fatigue may reflect temporary load or the completion of an older structure.

For example, familiar work can still function while offering little new space. The question is whether this is short-term tiredness or a structure nearing completion. Expansion without foundations may add load; selection after results have support can retain what works. This section examines transitions over time, complementing the earlier map of simultaneous life domains. Element roles cannot independently prescribe good and bad future periods.

sections.title: 当前时序
sections.headline: 己巳与丙寅，叠在原局之上
insights: 己土正印：支撑系统进入重点
丙寅叠加：责任与方向被强调
合冲害刑并存，不等于确定事件
interpretation: 当前读取范围为己巳大运与丙寅年度柱叠在庚申、甲子、庚辰、庚寅原局之上。己土正印把知识、制度、资源和可靠框架的重要性拉到前面；丙寅使责任、现实要求与个人方向一并被强调。重点不是只追求扩张或速度，而是原有基础能否承载新的要求。
甲己合只保留合的关系，不推出化土。巳申六合兼破、巳寅害与寅巳申刑同时可见；年度寅重复原局寅，冲原局申，也害大运巳。图中用层级与不同线型显示这些关系，没有用一个关系取消另一个，更不把它们换成事故、疾病或诉讼结论。
年度对应的公历年份、年龄与起运日期尚未明确，所以图示只呈现已提供的柱与关系。当前强调的是支撑、责任与方向之间的重新组织；具体生活里怎样表现，还要看现实条件。时序层补充原局的观察，不重写日主、强弱或用神判断。
sections.headlineZh: 己巳与丙寅，叠在原局之上
sections.headlineEn: Ji–Si and Bing–Yin overlay the natal chart
sections.subheadlineZh: 支撑、责任与方向一起被强调
sections.technicalCaptionZh: 原局庚申／甲子／庚辰／庚寅叠加己巳大运与丙寅年度。甲己仅论合，巳申六合兼破、巳寅害及寅巳申刑并存；年度寅重复原局寅、冲申并害巳。年份、年龄与起运未明确，不补写。
sections.technicalCaptionEn: The natal Geng–Shen / Jia–Zi / Geng–Chen / Geng–Yin chart is overlaid by Ji–Si Da Yun and Bing–Yin annual pillars. Jia–Ji combines without an Earth transformation conclusion. Si–Shen combination and break, harms, punishment, repeated Yin and Yin–Shen clash coexist. Unspecified dates and ages stay unspecified.
sections.applicationCaptionZh: 己土正印把支撑系统带到前面，丙寅同时强调责任与方向。机会、要求和基础需要一起理解；重新定界与逐步调整，可能比单纯加快更贴近当前结构，但不能由此断定某件事情必然发生。
sections.applicationCaptionEn: Ji Earth Direct Resource brings support systems forward; Bing–Yin emphasizes responsibility and direction. Opportunities, demands and foundations need to be read together. Clearer boundaries and gradual adjustment may fit this structure better than speed alone, without guaranteeing an event.
interpretationZh: 当前读取范围为己巳大运与丙寅年度柱叠在庚申、甲子、庚辰、庚寅原局之上。己土正印把知识、制度、资源和可靠框架的重要性拉到前面；丙寅使责任、现实要求与个人方向一并被强调。重点不是只追求扩张或速度，而是原有基础能否承载新的要求。
甲己合只保留合的关系，不推出化土。巳申六合兼破、巳寅害与寅巳申刑同时可见；年度寅重复原局寅，冲原局申，也害大运巳。图中用层级与不同线型显示这些关系，没有用一个关系取消另一个，更不把它们换成事故、疾病或诉讼结论。
年度对应的公历年份、年龄与起运日期尚未明确，所以图示只呈现已提供的柱与关系。当前强调的是支撑、责任与方向之间的重新组织；具体生活里怎样表现，还要看现实条件。时序层补充原局的观察，不重写日主、强弱或用神判断。
例如现实要求增加时，你可能一边需要更可靠的知识、制度或资源，一边又要决定哪些责任属于自己、哪些方向值得继续。己土与甲木的合，把支撑和资源之间的协调带到眼前；支系的合、破、害、刑与冲则让多种张力同时可见。它们不是单一吉凶标签，也不互相取消。具体表现仍要结合实际处境，当前时序只补充原局的观察，不改写日主、中和偏弱或土主金辅的读取。
interpretationEn: This reading overlays Ji–Si Da Yun and Bing–Yin annual pillars on the natal chart. Ji Direct Resource brings knowledge, systems and reliable frameworks forward; Bing–Yin highlights responsibility and direction. The question is whether foundations can carry developing requirements.

Jia–Ji is read as combination, without concluding Earth transformation. Si–Shen combines and breaks; Si–Yin harm and Yin–Si–Shen punishment coexist. Annual Yin repeats natal Yin, clashes with Shen and harms Si. One relationship does not cancel another.

Gregorian year, age and starting date are unspecified. The emphasis is on reorganizing support, responsibility and direction in light of real conditions. Timing supplements rather than rewrites Day Master, strength or useful directions.

For example, increased demands may require stronger knowledge, systems or resources while you decide which responsibilities and directions deserve continuation. Jia–Ji foregrounds coordination between support and resources; the branch relationships keep several tensions visible. They do not collapse into a single favorable or unfavorable verdict. Actual circumstances determine their expression, without guaranteed events.

diagrams.title: 四柱命盘
diagrams.caption: 以日干庚金为参照。年、月、日、时各自保留干支与藏干，柱位之间既有联系，也有不同的读取作用；这里不把四柱替换成固定年龄区间。日柱强调自我参照，四柱一起构成后续图表的原局基础。
diagrams.captionEn: The four pillars and their hidden stems preserve source position. Geng is the Day Master. Positions support later interpretation without fixed age bands.

diagrams.title: 五行结构
diagrams.caption: 数字来自四个天干、四个地支及十个藏干的未加权清单，共十八项。同一个字在不同位置出现会分别计入；这些数量让结构可见，却不是能量百分比、强弱评分或五行喜忌。强弱仍读取已接受的完整结构结论。
diagrams.captionEn: Counts cover four stems, four branches and ten hidden stems: eighteen unweighted entries. They are an inventory, not energy percentages or a strength score.

diagrams.title: 十神结构
diagrams.caption: 以庚日主为参照，统计已提供的其余三个天干与十个藏干，共十三项。日主自身不计入十神数量。零表示该清单没有相应记录，不代表一生没有此类作用；这里不增加运年十神，也不据数量单独决定职业、财富或关系。
diagrams.captionEn: The ten-god inventory covers three other visible stems and ten hidden stems. The Day Master itself is excluded. Zero denotes no entry in this inventory, not absence throughout life.

diagrams.title: 季节与日主
diagrams.caption: 子月的水势与三庚的判断一起读取，最终结构判断仍为中和偏弱。土的承载与金的边界保留为主辅条件；火有冬令调候与责任的作用。图示不以季节或三合单独改写强弱，也不把调候候选与用神层混为一谈。
diagrams.captionEn: Zi winter context, Geng judgment and Water output are read together. Strength remains moderately weak; Earth carries, Metal assists, and Fire retains warmth and responsibility.

diagrams.title: 原局支系关系
diagrams.caption: 申、子、辰的三合关系与寅申冲同时保留。三合的存在不表示已经完成化水，冲也不取消合。不同线型标示联系与张力，而不是关系强度；两种作用共同参与原局的理解、变化与方向选择。
diagrams.group: 申子辰三合关系成立 · 未确认化水
diagrams.captionEn: The Shen–Zi–Chen configuration and Yin–Shen clash remain together. Combination does not erase clash or establish complete Water transformation.

diagrams.title: 核心性格与能力
diagrams.caption: 三庚并见保留庚金的判断与边界，子月及申子辰水势使食伤表达突出，甲木偏财把输出接到现实价值。寅申冲保留方向张力；中和偏弱的判断要求以土承载、以金辅助，而非只增加输出。
diagrams.captionEn: Three Geng stems emphasize judgment and boundaries. Zi month and the Shen–Zi–Chen water configuration support expression through the Output stars; Jia Indirect Wealth connects output with practical value. Yin–Shen tension remains. The moderately weak reading calls for Earth support and Metal assistance.

diagrams.title: 人生结构与运行方式
diagrams.caption: 进入一个环境以后，你可能先理解规则，再承担责任，逐渐积累可用的方法与资源。阶段完成不必等于失败；当原来的安排不能容纳新的发展，重构可以延续已有基础，而不是把所有积累推倒。
diagrams.captionEn: You may enter an environment, learn its rules, take responsibility and accumulate methods and resources. Completing a stage need not mean failure. Reorganization can carry useful foundations forward when an earlier arrangement no longer holds the next development.
diagrams.titleEn: Life Structure & Operating Pattern · In practice

diagrams.title: 事业发展与职业方向
diagrams.caption: 庚金生食伤水，水再接甲木偏财；子中癸伤官当令、申中壬食神及辰中癸伤官提供输出来源。丙七杀藏寅带入责任，三庚保留自主判断，土金承载决定价值链能否持续，而非保证职位提升。
diagrams.captionEn: Geng Metal feeds Water Output, which connects with Jia Indirect Wealth. Gui Hurting Officer in Zi and Chen, and Ren Eating God in Shen, supply the output pathway. Bing Seven Killings hidden in Yin adds responsibility. Judgment and Earth–Metal support condition continuity.

diagrams.title: 资源与财富
diagrams.caption: 甲木偏财透月，乙木正财藏辰，显示机会流动与持续安排两类线索。三庚比肩让资源互动与自主边界进入读取，辰土提供承载与储存的解释意象。收入必须经过成本、责任和留存条件，不能直接等同财富。
diagrams.captionEn: Jia Indirect Wealth is exposed on the month stem; Yi Direct Wealth is hidden in Chen. Opportunity and continuity are distinct lenses. Three Geng Peer stars introduce resource interaction and boundaries; Chen offers a carrying and storage metaphor. Income is not automatically retained wealth.

diagrams.title: 关系与亲密模式
diagrams.caption: 甲木财星、日支辰、三庚判断与寅申冲共同提供关系读取线索。财星涉及现实连接，日支强调共同生活的承载，三庚保留自主边界，冲的张力使方向协调可见；这些线索不用于指定伴侣或断定关系结果。
diagrams.captionEn: Jia Wealth, the Chen day branch, three Geng stems and Yin–Shen tension anchor the relationship reading. They connect practical involvement, shared-life carrying, autonomy and direction. These lenses neither identify a destined partner nor determine a relationship outcome.

diagrams.title: 家庭与支持系统
diagrams.caption: 能处理问题的人，往往也更容易被交付更多责任。家庭支持要落实为谁处理事务、谁提供资源、谁承担照顾；可靠的分担同时保留各自发展空间，避免所有需要继续汇集到同一个人身上。
diagrams.captionEn: Someone who solves problems may also receive more responsibility. Family support becomes tangible through handling tasks, providing resources and sharing care. Dependable support preserves development space rather than concentrating every need on one person.

diagrams.title: 压力与脆弱点
diagrams.caption: 三庚的撑持、水势的理解输出与寅申冲的方向张力，使能力与负荷同时进入读取。中和偏弱保留承载条件，土提供基础、金提供边界。此处观察输入、责任与恢复怎样连接，不以五行或冲刑害作医学诊断。
diagrams.captionEn: Three Geng stems, water expression and Yin–Shen direction tension keep capability and load in view together. The moderately weak reading retains carrying conditions: Earth foundations and Metal boundaries. These are lenses on responsibility and recovery, not medical diagnosis.

diagrams.title: 长期周期与转折模式
diagrams.caption: 建立让基础逐渐可靠，扩张让成果进入更大范围，筛选让资源回到值得继续的部分，重组则为再建立创造条件。循环可以回访，也可以局部发生；它帮助理解阶段变化，不指定哪年或哪岁必须转折。
diagrams.captionEn: Building develops foundations; expansion extends results; selection returns resources to what merits continuation; reorganization enables renewed building. The cycle can recur or apply to one domain, without assigning a year or age to a transition.

diagrams.title: 当前时序
diagrams.caption: 原局庚申／甲子／庚辰／庚寅叠加己巳大运与丙寅年度。甲己仅论合，巳申六合兼破、巳寅害及寅巳申刑并存；年度寅重复原局寅、冲申并害巳。年份、年龄与起运未明确，不补写。
diagrams.captionEn: The natal Geng–Shen / Jia–Zi / Geng–Chen / Geng–Yin chart is overlaid by Ji–Si Da Yun and Bing–Yin annual pillars. Jia–Ji combines without an Earth transformation conclusion. Si–Shen combination and break, harms, punishment, repeated Yin and Yin–Shen clash coexist. Unspecified dates and ages stay unspecified.

diagrams.title: 当前激活关系
diagrams.caption: 原局庚申／甲子／庚辰／庚寅叠加己巳大运与丙寅年度。甲己仅论合，巳申六合兼破、巳寅害及寅巳申刑并存；年度寅重复原局寅、冲申并害巳。年份、年龄与起运未明确，不补写。

diagrams.captionEn: The natal Geng–Shen / Jia–Zi / Geng–Chen / Geng–Yin chart is overlaid by Ji–Si Da Yun and Bing–Yin annual pillars. Jia–Ji combines without an Earth transformation conclusion. Si–Shen combination and break, harms, punishment, repeated Yin and Yin–Shen clash coexist. Unspecified dates and ages stay unspecified.

diagrams.title: 让敏锐进入稳定结构
diagrams.caption: 在工作讨论里，你可能先发现方案的漏洞，再理解各方需求，最后把分散的信息重组成可用的方法。判断、理解、重组与落地不是性格分数，而是三庚、水势、财星与承载条件共同形成的观察路径。
diagrams.captionEn: In a work discussion, you may notice a weakness, understand competing needs, then reorganize scattered information into a useful method. Judgment, understanding, reorganization and implementation describe an interpretive pathway, rather than personality scores.

diagrams.title: 四柱的领域与位置
diagrams.caption: 年柱庚申、月柱甲子、日柱庚辰与时柱庚寅分别提供起点、社会现实、自我位置与后续方向的观察线索。申子辰三合条件与寅申冲同时保留，稳定与重构并存，不把柱位换算为固定年龄。
diagrams.captionEn: Geng–Shen, Jia–Zi, Geng–Chen and Geng–Yin provide lenses on origins, social reality, self-position and later direction. The Shen–Zi–Chen configuration and Yin–Shen clash coexist, linking stability and reorganization without assigning fixed ages to pillar positions.

diagrams.title: 责任、权限与资源
diagrams.caption: 专业认知经过可用方案、客户或组织采用，才能形成可重复的价值。责任增加时，需要同步理解权限、资源与结果的关系；否则方法仍可能困在一个人的忙碌里，难以成为可靠的交付结构。
diagrams.captionEn: Professional cognition becomes repeatable value through usable solutions and adoption by customers or organizations. Greater responsibility also needs authority, resources and results to align; otherwise useful methods can remain trapped in one person’s workload.

diagrams.captionEn: Professional cognition becomes repeatable value through usable solutions and adoption by customers or organizations. Greater responsibility also needs authority, resources and results to align; otherwise useful methods can remain trapped in one person’s workload.

diagrams.title: 资源的三个层次
diagrams.caption: 收入经过留存、配置与持久资源，才逐渐形成选择空间。外部机会越多，越要辨认时间、成本和责任如何影响留下来的部分；图示呈现条件之间的联系，不提供投资产品、回报率或资产估值。
diagrams.captionEn: Income passes through retention, allocation and durable resources before expanding choice. Opportunities also consume time, cost and responsibility. The diagram shows these conditions; it does not prescribe investments, returns or asset values.

diagrams.title: 机会与留存条件
diagrams.caption: 收入经过留存、配置与持久资源，才逐渐形成选择空间。外部机会越多，越要辨认时间、成本和责任如何影响留下来的部分；图示呈现条件之间的联系，不提供投资产品、回报率或资产估值。
diagrams.captionEn: Income passes through retention, allocation and durable resources before expanding choice. Opportunities also consume time, cost and responsibility. The diagram shows these conditions; it does not prescribe investments, returns or asset values.

diagrams.title: 吸引与长期结构
diagrams.caption: 吸引让彼此靠近，一致行动让信任积累，边界让共同生活保持清楚。短期好感与长期标准并不相同；压力出现时能否回应、承诺能否兑现，以及未来安排怎样共同承担，才让关系逐渐进入现实。
diagrams.captionEn: Attraction brings people closer; consistent action builds trust; boundaries clarify shared life. Initial chemistry and long-term criteria differ. Responsiveness under pressure, fulfilled commitments and shared future arrangements make the relationship practical.

diagrams.title: 责任怎样成为共同承担
diagrams.caption: 年柱庚申提供早期秩序的线索，日支辰涉及共同生活承载，时柱庚寅保留后续方向；寅申冲让前后位置的张力可见。家庭图用角色表达资源与照顾分配，不把柱位解释成固定年龄，也不假设你已有伴侣或子女。
diagrams.captionEn: Geng–Shen offers an early-order lens, Chen concerns shared-life carrying, and Geng–Yin retains later direction. Yin–Shen tension connects these positions. The family map depicts roles and support; it assumes neither fixed ages nor an existing partner or children.

diagrams.title: 负荷与恢复的循环
diagrams.caption: 信息输入与责任累积可能持续占用理解和判断；外部仍能交付，不代表内部还有同样多的余量。支持进入、重新定界与恢复空间，让负荷回到可承载范围，而不是把每次放慢都解释为能力下降。
diagrams.captionEn: Information and responsibility may continuously occupy understanding and judgment. Continuing to deliver does not prove that internal capacity is unchanged. Support, renewed boundaries and recovery space can make the load manageable without treating slower movement as lost ability.

diagrams.title: 五行角色，不是固定运程序列
diagrams.caption: 土承载、金定界、水理解输出、木连接资源、火调候并带入责任，是本盘保留的功能角色。寅申冲与三合水势并存，使积累和转向可以同时发生；这些作用不构成木火土金水的必经年代顺序。
diagrams.captionEn: Earth carries, Metal sets boundaries, Water understands and expresses, Wood connects resources, and Fire brings seasonal warmth and responsibility. Yin–Shen tension coexists with the water configuration. These functions do not form an inevitable sequence of life periods.

diagrams.title: 当前的三个强调
diagrams.caption: 己土正印把支撑系统带到前面，丙寅同时强调责任与方向。机会、要求和基础需要一起理解；重新定界与逐步调整，可能比单纯加快更贴近当前结构，但不能由此断定某件事情必然发生。
diagrams.captionEn: Ji Earth Direct Resource brings support systems forward; Bing–Yin emphasizes responsibility and direction. Opportunities, demands and foundations need to be read together. Clearer boundaries and gradual adjustment may fit this structure better than speed alone, without guaranteeing an event.

diagrams.title: 贯穿全文的运行结构
diagrams.caption: 判断与理解形成能力，输出要经过现实采用才成为价值；关系、家庭和恢复空间又决定这些成果能否长期承载。周期与时序补充方向上的变化。它们是可以与你生活对照的结构，而不是分数、人物分类或预定事件。
diagrams.captionEn: Geng judgment, Water expression and Jia Wealth connect understanding with practical value. Earth and Metal carrying conditions remain; current timing is Ji–Si with Bing–Yin.

diagrams.title: 你的命盘，一眼看见
diagrams.caption: 三庚、子月、水势与甲木，共同参与判断、理解、输出和现实价值的读取。中和偏弱结论要求保留承载条件；己巳与丙寅只是目前提供的时序层。各图分别展开事实与解释，不把任何单一特征当成完整的人生结论。
diagrams.captionEn: Geng judgment, Water expression and Jia Wealth connect understanding with practical value. Earth and Metal carrying conditions remain; current timing is Ji–Si with Bing–Yin.

如有现实问题，下一次对照可以从一个具体情境开始：发生了什么、涉及谁、你希望理解哪部分。当前报告没有收到个人现实描述，因此没有为你推定额外经历。
